evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live R436 CustomInterfaceRegistry catalogue.
Its build method looks up existing widget 6960 rather than creating an independent root and replaces that widget's child arrays with a six-child layout.
It creates exactly two selectable controls, widget 30583 labeled '1' and widget 30584 labeled '2', both with exact tooltip 'Select option', and marks both controls active.
It also creates widget 6961 with text 'Close Window' and tooltip 'Close'; the remaining children 6962, 6963 and 6964 are existing companion widgets in the same patched root.
No surviving exact-v308 literal or independent consumer proves what semantic choices '1' and '2' represent, so the name stops at the observable two-option interface-patch behavior.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 behavior name for a builder that patches root 6960 with two generic selection controls and a close control; the business meaning of choices 1/2 is intentionally unresolved.
